description: This file defines the 'Delete' feature for articles, including command validation and handling the deletion process from the database using Entity Framework Core.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the Slug property of the command is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the deletion of an article identified by its slug, throwing an error if the article does not exist.

methods.name: Delete.QueryHandler.Handle
methods.description: Executes the deletion of the article from the database, ensuring proper error handling if the article isn't found.
